releaseNotes.en: First version: your Steam name and the game you are playing.
releaseNotes.fr: Première version : votre nom Steam et le jeu en cours.

justifications.text: Reads the player's own Steam profile with their Steam Web API key, in a header, on one GET route; it writes nothing.
Reads the player's name and current game, every 5 minutes at most.
Keeps the player's public Steam ID between two games.

reviewMessage: Test with any Steam account and its key from steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey; the widget sends only the Steam ID the player typed.
